agent_summary: P6-P2 human gate for the SDTMIG 3.4 full navigation map and the bounded Core/Events/AE deep locator layer. Approval accepts structure and traceability only; it does not promote knowledge statements or publish restricted source text.

findings.current_value: 461/461 pages and 220/220 outline entries are mapped with zero unexplained pages.
findings.proposed_value: Approve the page-to-outline navigation layer as the P2 full-document coverage baseline.
findings.rationale: Navigation coverage prevents later extraction from silently skipping source regions.
findings.title: Accept the full-document navigation coverage baseline

findings.current_value: 63 domains, 704 PDF table boundaries, 63 dataset rows, and 1917 variable rows are indexed with no skipped data rows.
findings.proposed_value: Approve the PDF navigation boundaries and structured workbook index as complementary source structure.
findings.rationale: PDF and XLSX provide different locator granularity and must remain separately traceable.
findings.title: Accept PDF boundary detection and XLSX row indexing

findings.current_value: The approved 100-page scope contains 844 paragraph units, 177 assumption roles, 289 examples, and 85 cross-reference units.
findings.proposed_value: Approve deep segmentation only for Core chapters 1-4, section 6.2 Events, and section 6.2.1 AE.
findings.rationale: A bounded deep layer preserves retrieval quality without claiming full-book paragraph extraction.
findings.title: Accept the bounded Core and Events deep-locator scope

findings.current_value: All 204 Events PDF variable rows align to 204 workbook rows across seven domains with no missing, ambiguous, or order-difference result.
findings.proposed_value: Approve the 204 typed alignment references as the Events variable trace baseline.
findings.rationale: Variable-level traceability is required before extracting executable SDTM guidance.
findings.title: Accept Events PDF-to-XLSX variable alignment

findings.current_value: The AE specification is one table unit with four page locators on pages 134-137 and 60/60 PDF/XLSX variable rows.
findings.proposed_value: Approve the cross-page AE table boundary and the first/middle/last locator visual checks.
findings.rationale: Treating continuation pages as unrelated tables would break AE variable context and citations.
findings.title: Accept the AE cross-page table locator

findings.current_value: 117 SDTMIG section references resolve internally, five SDTM or ICH E3 references remain typed external dependencies, and none are unresolved.
findings.proposed_value: Approve the reference closure and preserve external standards as dependencies rather than guessed SDTMIG targets.
findings.rationale: Typed reference boundaries prevent missing citations and false internal links.
findings.title: Accept internal and external reference classification

findings.current_value: All seven P2-expressible Gold locators match at field level; the web erratum remains explicitly outside the PDF/XLSX map.
findings.proposed_value: Approve 7/7 Gold compatibility without converting the release-page erratum into a false source locator.
findings.rationale: Gold preservation anchors later extraction while keeping source modalities honest.
findings.title: Accept P1 Gold locator compatibility

findings.current_value: The local maps match the committed base hash 15e6db580a3b6c4d5bef56c9a30fcc59c1463a820295e5ce7792c5654e092a76 and deep hash 56d35561c70504e0fa1b631a0809d563591cbaf629264626eae4cd73831c2cbc; each hash was reproduced in two recorded runs.
findings.proposed_value: Approve ignored rebuildable maps plus committed generators, tests, and compact hash/count reports as the P2 storage boundary.
findings.rationale: This keeps restricted content out of Git and Obsidian while preserving deterministic reconstruction and drift detection.
findings.title: Accept hash-locked rebuild identity and storage boundary
